ASK for input.description: Ask a question, wait for a fresh reply, and store the answer.

DO a task.description: Complete an agent task and store its result.

PRINT a value.description: Display an existing value or exact expression.

PRINT an instruction.description: Compose a response from information already available.

IF a condition.description: Run an indented body when the condition is true.

IF / ELSE branches.description: Choose between two branches with aligned IF and ELSE.

CONTEXT background text.description: Store literal background text in an aligned AS binding.

body: DO ${2:Describe the task for @input and return its result.}
COMMAND definition.description: Group instructions in a plain command block with isolated @input.
